verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You loved me
When I was so unlovely

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You sought me
When I was lost

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
You showed me
How much You really loved me

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
When you bought me
At the highest cost

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
There's no greater love than this
There's no greater love than this
That a man would give his life for a friend

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
There's no higher sacrifice
Than a man would give his life
You have paid a precious price for me

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You chose me
When I was so unworthy

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
You cleansed me
With Your own blood

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
You clothe me
With righteousness and mercy

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
And You crowned me
With Your steadfast love
